import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int numerator_input = scanner.nextInt();
        int denominator_input = scanner.nextInt();
        int max_n = scanner.nextInt();

        final int INFINITY_VAL = 99999999;

        double min_difference = INFINITY_VAL;
        int best_num = 0;
        int best_den = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= max_n; ++i) {
            int approx_num = (int) Math.round(1.0 * numerator_input * i / denominator_input - 0.0000001);
            double diff = Math.abs((1.0 * numerator_input / denominator_input) - (1.0 * approx_num / i));
            if (diff < min_difference) {
                best_num = approx_num;
                best_den = i;
                min_difference = diff;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(best_num + "/" + best_den);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
